content_sections.heading: GMDC Job Profile: Key Responsibilities (Post-wise)
content_sections.text: The Boiler Expert will act as a technical advisor to industrial clients, visiting plant sites to audit boiler performance and recommend efficiency improvements. Key responsibilities include: Conducting on-site technical audits of operating boiler systems and identifying efficiency bottlenecks. Assessing compatibility of client boilers with lignite fuel blends and guiding operational adjustments. Suggesting design and engineering modifications to improve heat transfer and fuel mixing. Engaging with plant stakeholders and explaining the return on investment of recommended changes. Training sales managers and boiler operators on boiler fundamentals. This role requires being based in Gujarat or willing to relocate, with extensive travel (more than 15 days a month) to industrial zones such as Ahmedabad, Surat, Morbi, and Dahej. This role heads survey operations for GMDC's Coal and Lignite mining projects, ensuring statutory compliance. Key responsibilities include: Supervising mine survey operations and ensuring compliance with the Mines Act, DGMS requirements, and Coal Mines Regulations. Preparing, maintaining, and certifying statutory mine plans, sections, and survey records. Providing survey data for mine planning, resource and reserve estimation, and volumetric calculations. Implementing modern survey technologies such as Total Station, DGPS/GPS, Drone/UAV survey, LiDAR, GIS-based survey management, and digital terrain modeling. Leading and mentoring survey teams, and coordinating with DGMS, IBM, and state authorities. This role leads mining operations of large mechanized opencast coal mines. Key responsibilities include: Managing day-to-day coal mining operations as per approved mining plans and statutory provisions. Functioning as a statutory official under CMR 2017 and liaising with DGMS, Ministry of Coal, state mining authorities, and pollution control boards. Achieving targeted coal production, overburden removal, and dispatch plans. Implementing safety management systems, conducting risk assessments, and driving a strong safety culture. Supervising mining contractors, validating contractor bills, and optimizing manpower and equipment deployment. Overseeing environmental compliance, reclamation, afforestation, and sustainable mining practices. This role manages laboratory operations, quality control, and chemical analysis functions across GMDC's mining, lignite, and power operations. Key responsibilities include: Conducting chemical analysis and testing of minerals, lignite, coal, ores, water, and effluents as per approved standards. Operating, maintaining, and calibrating laboratory instruments, and supporting QA/QC systems. Monitoring process parameters and providing analytical support for mining and beneficiation operations. Ensuring laboratory safety, proper chemical handling, and compliance with environmental, health, and safety regulations. Supporting environmental monitoring and regulatory compliance, including Environmental Clearance

content_sections.heading: GMDC Recruitment 2026 Terms of Contract
content_sections.text: Boiler Expert: Contractual engagement for an initial period of one (1) year, extendable by one year based on performance and business requirement. DGM/Sr. Manager (Survey) and DGM/Sr. Manager (Coal-I): Contractual engagement for an initial period of two (2) years, extendable by one year based on performance and business requirement. Assistant Manager/Management Trainee (Chemistry): Contractual engagement for an initial period of two (2) years, extendable by one year based on performance and business requirement. Across all posts, the engagement does not confer any right to regular appointment in the organization. The contract can be terminated by either side at any time by giving one month's prior notice or pay in lieu of the notice period.
